x-flowapi-covers: req: oas-3.2.media-type-object.prefixEncoding — multipart/mixed: its three Encoding Objects by position
req: oas-3.2.media-type-object.itemEncoding — multipart/mixed: the items after them by items' schema; multipart/form-data's itemEncoding kept for its array form
req: oas-3.2.media-type-object.prefixEncoding.shall-prefixencoding-field-only-apply-media-type — the form's prefixEncoding read nowhere
req: oas-3.2.media-type-object.encoding.shall-encoding-field-only-apply-media-type — multipart/mixed's encoding (by name, for no named type) read nowhere

req: oas-3.2.media-type-object.encoding-usage-and-restrictions.shall-each-field-own-set-media-types — encoding for the form and multipart/form-data, prefixEncoding and itemEncoding for multipart, none for JSON
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.headers.shall-field-ignored-media-type-not-multipart — n: the form's headers give nothing
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.style.shall-field-ignored-media-type-not-application — multipart/mixed's Encoding Objects: no style read; the form's n: explode read
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.explode.shall-field-ignored-media-type-not-application — explode read for the form only here
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.allowReserved.shall-field-ignored-media-type-not-application — allowReserved read for no multipart/mixed part
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.encoding — meta: its nested encoding by name, read for its multipart/form-data
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.prefixEncoding — the second part: its nested prefixEncoding, as 3.2's own example
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.itemEncoding — deep: nested itemEncoding read
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.nested-encoding.must-implementations-support-one-level-nesting-support — the second part and meta nested one level; deep read to four levels, the fifth a warning
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.common-fixed-fields.may-object-extended-specification-extensions — the second part's x-note read as nothing
req: oas-3.2.encoding-object.content-transfer-encoding-and-contentencoding.shall-note-stated-working-binary-data-encoding — shot: image/jpeg, not contentMediaType image/png

req: oas-3.2.schema-object.non-json-data.must-inspecting-schemas-given-starting-point-schema — scan: contentEncoding behind $ref then allOf then $ref makes it application/octet-stream; the third part and the items likewise, with Content-Transfer-Encoding
req: oas-3.2.schema-object.non-json-data.must-not-implementations-inspect-subschemas-possible-reference-targets — either: a contentEncoding inside oneOf is not looked into, no type is guessed

req: oas-3.2.schema-object.non-json-data.must-due-limited-requirements-searching-schemas-serializers — a code generator falls back to the schemas: what the data cannot tell (a string's text encoded) the table says
